newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone threatens shipping in Coral Sea - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone threatens shipping in Coral Sea - WSC.

text.p: Tropical cyclone Justin will remain a significant risk to shipping in Coral Sea to the east of Cairns, Australia over the next few days, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Monday.

Top winds are currently 65 mph but they may increase to 70-75 mph during the next 48-72 hours. The system is currently about 400 miles east of Cairns and is nearly stationary. It should drift westward for the next 24-48 hours.
This track will keep it well east of the Australia coast for the next few days but it does bear watching.
